transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Arjun. How can I help you today?
Customer: I am so sick of this! My internet has been dropping every ten minutes for the last three days. It is completely unusable!
Agent: I am very sorry to hear that you are experiencing these drops. I know how frustrating it is when your connection is unstable.
Agent: Before we look into the account, could you please provide your account number?
Customer: My name is Karan Nair and my account number is 41055424.
Agent: Thank you, Mr. Nair. I see your address is 239 MG Road. Is that correct?
Customer: Yes, that is correct. I just want this fixed now.
Agent: I have run a diagnostic on your line and it looks like there is a signal instability issue at the local exchange. I can see the drops in the logs.
Customer: Finally, someone sees it. I also need to pay my outstanding balance so it doesn't get cut off. My phone number is 96651 19718.
Agent: I can help with that. Please go ahead and provide the card details for the payment.
Customer: It is four seven three seven five zero four three one zero three nine nine three one nine.
Agent: The payment has been processed successfully. Now, regarding the network issue, I am going to raise a network ticket to have the exchange port reset and monitored.
